sender.en: A call from a “Touch 'n Go representative” offering a new card with perks

name.ms: “Wakil Touch 'n Go” palsu yang menawarkan kad baharu, kemudian mengambil alih e-dompet
name.en: Fake “Touch 'n Go representative” offering a new card, then taking over your eWallet

how.ms: Seseorang menelefon dan mengaku wakil Touch 'n Go, menawarkan kad baharu dengan mata ganjaran, baucar diskaun sehingga 80 peratus dan boleh digunakan di luar negara. Selepas anda bersetuju, dia meminta anda membuka aplikasi TNG eWallet dan mengikut arahannya langkah demi langkah. Tanpa anda sedar, arahan itu memberinya kawalan ke atas akaun, lalu baki, subsidi dan mata ganjaran anda diambil. Persatuan pengguna Kedah melaporkan beberapa orang lain turut menjadi sasaran, dan Touch 'n Go menyatakan ia tidak pernah melantik ejen untuk mengumpul maklumat peribadi pelanggan.
how.en: Someone calls claiming to be a Touch 'n Go representative and offers a new card with reward points, discount vouchers of up to 80 per cent and the ability to spend overseas. Once you agree, they ask you to open the TNG eWallet app and follow their instructions step by step. Without you realising, the instructions give them control of the account, and your balance, subsidy and reward points are taken. A Kedah consumer association reported that several other people were also targeted, and Touch 'n Go says it has never appointed agents to collect customers' personal information.

text.ms: Panggilan tidak diminta daripada “wakil Touch 'n Go”.
text.en: An unsolicited call from a “Touch 'n Go representative”.

text.ms: Tawaran kad baharu dengan ganjaran dan baucar yang sangat menarik.
text.en: An offer of a new card with very attractive rewards and vouchers.

text.ms: Anda diminta membuka aplikasi e-dompet dan mengikut arahan semasa panggilan.
text.en: You are asked to open your eWallet app and follow instructions during the call.

text.ms: Arahan itu memberi penipu akses kepada akaun anda.
text.en: The instructions give the scammer access to your account.

text.ms: Pemanggil: Selamat petang, saya dari Touch 'n Go. Puan terpilih untuk kad baharu percuma dengan mata ganjaran dan baucar diskaun sampai 80%. Sekarang puan buka aplikasi eWallet, saya bantu aktifkan, ikut langkah saya ya, nanti ada kod masuk.
text.en: Caller: Good afternoon, I'm from Touch 'n Go. You have been selected for a free new card with reward points and discount vouchers of up to 80%. Now open your eWallet app, I'll help you activate it, follow my steps, a code will come in shortly.

ms: Panggilan yang tidak anda minta daripada “wakil” e-dompet atau bank.
Disuruh membuka aplikasi dan mengikut arahan semasa masih dalam talian.
Ganjaran yang terlalu menarik untuk kad yang anda tidak pohon.
en: A call you didn't ask for from an eWallet or bank “representative”.
Being told to open your app and follow instructions while still on the line.
Rewards that are too good for a card you never applied for.

ms: Letak telefon. Mohon kad atau perkhidmatan hanya melalui aplikasi rasmi Touch 'n Go.
Jangan berikan kod, PIN atau ikut arahan dalam aplikasi daripada pemanggil.
Jika akaun anda sudah diakses, hubungi Touch 'n Go melalui aplikasi rasmi, bank anda dan 997, kemudian buat laporan polis.
en: Hang up. Apply for cards or services only through the official Touch 'n Go app.
Don't give codes or PINs, or follow in-app instructions from a caller.
If your account has been accessed, contact Touch 'n Go through its official app, your bank and 997, then make a police report.

sources.title: Touch ‘n Go warns of scam callers posing as company agents
‘Touch ‘n Go rep’ scam leaves Kedah woman RM150 poorer, says consumer group

story.ms: Seorang wanita bekerja sendiri berusia 39 tahun di Kedah ditelefon oleh seseorang yang mengaku wakil Touch 'n Go dan menawarkan kad baharu dengan mata ganjaran, baucar dan boleh digunakan di luar negara. Selepas dia bersetuju, pemanggil memintanya membuka aplikasi e-dompet dan mengikut arahan tertentu; tanpa disedari, penipu mengambil alih aplikasi itu. Dia kehilangan kira-kira RM150, termasuk subsidi petrol BUDI95 dan mata ganjarannya.
story.en: A 39-year-old self-employed woman in Kedah was called by someone claiming to be a Touch 'n Go representative, offering a new card with reward points, vouchers and overseas spending. After she agreed, the caller asked her to open her eWallet app and follow certain instructions; without her knowing, the scammer took over the app. She lost about RM150, including her BUDI95 petrol subsidy and reward points.
